backup.title: Back up your key

pending.title: Membership pending

denied.title: Membership denied
denied.description: Your request to join was denied.

avatar.title: Next, add a display image
avatar.subtitle: Choose an image or emoji as your avatar

backup_step.title_created: Your unique identity key has been created
backup_step.never_share: Never share your private key. Anyone with this key can impersonate you and access everything in your account.
backup_step.options_description: Your identity key works like a password for your Buzz account. Keep a copy somewhere safe. You can create a backup file and lock it with a password you can remember.
backup_step.storage_keyring_description: Buzz keeps your identity key in your system keychain. Your computer may ask for your password when Buzz needs to read the key.
backup_step.storage_file_description: Your system keychain wasn't available, so Buzz keeps your identity key in a private file on this device.
backup_step.storage_device_description: Buzz keeps your identity key protected on this device. Make a separate backup in case you lose access.
backup_step.storage_keyring_intro: Buzz keeps your identity key in your system keychain.
backup_step.storage_file_intro: Buzz keeps your identity key in a private file on this device because the system keychain wasn't available.
backup_step.storage_device_intro: Your identity key is protected on this device.
backup_step.pm_description: Copy your identity key, then save it in a password manager like 1Password.
backup_step.locked_file_description: Create a backup file and choose a password you can remember. You'll need both to restore your account.
backup_step.error_copy_detail: Could not retrieve your private key: {{error}}. You can continue and find it later in Settings > Profile > Identity.

backup_test.error_wrong_backup: That doesn't look like your key backup. Choose the file you just downloaded.
backup_test.error_not_backup: That doesn't look like a key backup file.
backup_test.error_different_backup: That's a key backup, but not the one you just downloaded.
backup_test.success_description: File and password verified. Keep them both somewhere safe — that's all you need to restore your identity.
backup_test.matches_current: It restores your current Buzz identity.
backup_test.matches_other: It restores a different identity than the one signed in here.
backup_test.unlock_hint: Enter the password to prove you can unlock this backup.

community_flow.build_profile_description: Add a name and avatar. They'll show up on your messages, reactions, and agent handoffs.
community_flow.team_description: Buzz lets you bring multiple agents into the same workspace. Your team will help you get started using Buzz.

download.title_create: Backup your key with a password
download.desc_verified: Your file and password can restore your identity.
download.desc_selected: Now enter your password to prove you can unlock it.
download.desc_created: Learn how your backup works. Drop the file you just saved and unlock it with your password.
download.desc_create: Keep the downloaded file private — you need both it and your password to restore your identity. Save the backup password somewhere safe; Buzz cannot reset it if lost.

encrypted_backup.password_saved_sr: Backup password saved; hidden for security.
encrypted_backup.saved_hint: Your password isn't kept — download another copy anytime, or start over to choose a new password.
encrypted_backup.dialog_description: Starting over lets you pick a new password and download a fresh backup file. Backups you saved earlier will still work — just use the password you created them with.

keyring.title: Unlock your system keyring
keyring.description: Your identity is safe in the OS keyring, but it's unreachable this session. Unlock your keyring or sign into your desktop session, then relaunch Buzz.

machine.tagline: Your people, your agents, your projects — all in one place.
machine.desc_unlock: Enter your backup password to unlock your key and restore your identity.
machine.desc_reimport: Your identity is no longer in the system keyring. Re-import your nsec to restore it.
machine.desc_enter_key: If you already have a Buzz account, enter your private key below to get started.

membership_denied.error_invalid_nsec: That doesn't look like a valid nsec. Paste an nsec1 key.
membership_denied.title: Not a member yet
membership_denied.description: This relay requires an invitation. Ask a relay admin to add you as a member, then come back and try again.
membership_denied.share_hint: This is your public identity — it's safe to share. Send it to the relay admin so they can invite you.

flow.error_create_identity: Failed to create a new identity. Please try again.
flow.relay_unreachable_desc: Check your connection or change your community.
flow.relay_error_desc: The relay returned an error. Try again.
flow.reimport_desc: Your identity is no longer in the system keyring. Re-import your nsec to restore it — Buzz will restart to finish recovery. Or go back to start a new identity with a fresh key.
flow.use_existing_desc: Import your Nostr private key to use that identity with Buzz. If this key already has a profile on the relay, your name and avatar are restored automatically.
flow.reconnect_error: Could not reconnect to the relay. {{detail}}

profile_step.title: What should we call you?
profile_step.description: Pick the name people and agents will see in Buzz. You can change it anytime.

relaunch.title: Restart Buzz to finish recovery
relaunch.body: Your identity was updated. Buzz needs to restart so syncing and agents run under it.

reset_failed.title: Sign out could not complete
reset_failed.body: Buzz was unable to fully clear your local data. Try relaunching — the reset will resume automatically. If this persists, contact support.

setup.title: Set up your agent harnesses
setup.description: Buzz checks for command-line harnesses on this machine. Install the CLI or sign in to at least one to continue.
setup.no_harnesses: No supported command-line harnesses were detected yet. Install a supported CLI, then check again.
setup.config_invalid_detail: Check this runtime's configuration and try again.
setup.detail_adapter_outdated: ACP adapter detected but outdated — reinstall required.

config.error_save: Couldn't save your default harness. Try again.
config.loading_error: Couldn't load harness settings. Go back and try again.
config.title: Configure your default model settings
